title: Poison Gas Bomb
body:
Syntax: poison gas bomb <target>

Description: Attaches a consumed Poison Gas Bomb. After two combat pulses it deals 12-23 damage and poisons the target unless disabled. Requires a carried poison gas bomb. Bukijutsu unlocks at level 40. Costs 40 Chakra and 15 Stamina; 8 second cooldown.

Date: 2026-09-27
